description: Israel's Central Bureau of Statistics publishes a water and sewage topic in its statistics, drawing on data from the Meteorological Service, the Water Authority, the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Environmental Protection and its own local authority data. The topic page read on 2026-09-28 explains that it covers the types of water by source, their quantity and quality, and their uses in households, industry and agriculture, as well as raw sewage. Subtopics cover precipitation and rain days, the state of water resources, water production and supply and water consumption, each with financial and quantity data, water quality, sewage treatment and a water account, alongside publications and a presentation. The bureau's site also offers an interface for programs and a terms-of-use page. Coverage is Israel, with local authority detail in some series. Access is free; the licence terms were not read, and the individual tables and their years were not opened. Caveats: many series come from other agencies and follow their definitions. It supports water supply and wastewater capacity studies, such as relating municipal consumption to desalination and treatment capacity. Related record: the CBS 2022 census tables by statistical area.
